caption: The drawing depicts a single barrel-shaped vessel made of ceramic or similar material, rendered in shades of beige and blue-gray. The vessel has a wide opening at the top and is decorated with three blue bands encircling the upper half, and one band encircling the lower half. Along the upper portion, there are two rows of eight-pointed stars, also in blue, arranged between the blue bands. On the central portion of the vessel, there is a prominent raised depiction of an eagle with outstretched wings, perched on a circular crest or medallion. Additional blue decorative elements, such as curving horizontal bands and edging, accent the form. At the bottom front center, there is a protruding blue circular section, possibly representing a spout or bung hole. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or features. In the lower right corner, the artist's signature "John Warstler" appears.
title: Wine Keg
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
